digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, single-turn criterion routing, container pass prefix caching
propositions: Plan review certified tickets whose acceptance criteria and scope declarations are mutually unsatisfiable, with contradictions surfacing only after implementation or at the verifier gate, forcing late re-review and invalidating attestations.
No existing plan-review criterion owns detection of within-ticket acceptance-criteria satisfiability; COH covers cross-section contradictions but explicitly disclaims within-section ones.

G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire because the sibling roster it receives contains only child ids and titles, lacking the acceptance-criteria items needed to test whether sibling criteria collectively cover each parent criterion.

The sibling roster-building expression is duplicated independently in three non-test call sites (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py), causing divergence in what data the eval harnesses send versus production, which corrupts dogfooding data for G3's deferred posture decision.

The roster must move from per-pairing instructions into the byte-stable system prompt prefix to be cached once rather than re-sent per pairing, and its token cost must be included in the parent_tokens prefix estimate that gates caching and bin-packing.
